# Reviewed under AGENTS.md


def insertion_point(xs, x):
    """Return the leftmost index at which ``x`` can be inserted into the sorted list ``xs``.

    Equivalent to ``bisect.bisect_left(xs, x)``: the returned index is the first position
    whose element is not less than ``x``, so duplicates of ``x`` end up to its right.
    """
    lo, hi = 0, len(xs)
    while lo < hi:
        mid = (lo + hi) // 2
        if xs[mid] < x:
            lo = mid + 1
        else:
            hi = mid
    return lo
